title: Pure @Ignister
summary: @Ignister monsters with their A.I. Spells and generic staples. The deck link-climbs through Dark Infant @Ignister and Ignister A.I.Land into Dark Templar @Ignister, the 2300 ATK @Ignister bosses, Allied Code Talker @Ignister, and The Arrival Cyberse @Ignister while locking you into Cyberse monsters.

summary.title: Starters
points: Achichi @Ignister searches any Level 4 or lower @Ignister monster (except Achichi) on Normal or Special Summon.
Pikari @Ignister searches any A.I. Spell or Trap on Normal or Special Summon and can change an @Ignister's Level to 4.
A.I. Meet You reveals a 2300 ATK Cyberse monster in your Extra Deck to search an @Ignister monster with the same Attribute.
Backup @Ignister Special Summons itself from the hand while you control a Cyberse monster Special Summoned from the Extra Deck, then searches a DARK Cyberse monster and discards 1 card.

summary.title: Opening: Achichi @Ignister
steps: Normal Summon Achichi @Ignister to search Pikari @Ignister, then Link Summon Dark Infant @Ignister in the Extra Monster Zone to search Ignister A.I.Land.
Activate Ignister A.I.Land and Special Summon Pikari @Ignister to search A.I. Meet You (or A.I.dle Reborn), then use Backup @Ignister and Wizard @Ignister to extend.

Climb into Dark Templar @Ignister, move Dark Infant and change its Attribute when a monster is summoned to Templar's linked zone, and revive up to 3 Level 4 or lower @Ignisters with different names from your GY.
Tune and overlay into Wind Pegasus @Ignister and Light Dragon @Ignister, then link into Allied Code Talker @Ignister or a multi-Attribute The Arrival Cyberse @Ignister.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Allied Code Talker @Ignister revives as many 2300 ATK Cyberse monsters as possible from your GY to its linked zones on Link Summon, and Tributes a linked monster as a Quick Effect to negate and banish any card or effect.

The Arrival Cyberse @Ignister is summoned using monsters with different Attributes, gains 1000 original ATK per material, is unaffected by other cards' effects, and destroys 1 monster on the field once per turn while spawning a Token.

Danmari @Ignister banishes itself from the field or GY while you control a Link-6 monster to negate any face-up card's effects, Kurikurinku @Ignister Tributes itself to negate targeting effects, and Wind Pegasus @Ignister banishes itself from the field or GY to shuffle an opponent's card into the Deck when your card is destroyed.

summary.title: Spells
points: Ignister A.I.Land lets you Special Summon one Level 4 or lower @Ignister per Attribute from your hand while your Main Monster Zones are empty, and recycles itself from the GY by banishing an @Ignister.

A.I.dle Reborn revives an @Ignister from the GY as a Quick-Play Spell and banishes itself from the GY to recover an A.I. Spell/Trap, while A.I. Contact shuffles a spare Ignister A.I.Land from hand to bottom of Deck to draw 3 cards.

summary.title: Left out
summary.text: The page's Maliss hybrid engine is left out to keep the deck pure @Ignister.

Link Material from the hand; destroys Spells/Traps when used.
